name: Motel One Innsbruck
beschreibung: Motel One Innsbruck is centrally located in Innsbruck's city center, just a few minutes' walk from the historic Old Town and the Goldenes Dachl. The hotel offers contemporary design with a clear pricing concept. The rooms are functionally furnished, and Wi-Fi is included. On the ground floor there is a lounge that serves as a breakfast area during the day. Paid parking options are available in the underground garage.
